oldLoop:
(defn- gn-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64] :vector-i64
  (if (and (< i (vector-at M MM-SIR-N)) (= (vector-at M MM-ERR) 0))
    (let [M1 (gn-ins M i (gn-op M i))
          k (gn-g M1 gn-f-skip)]
      (gn-loop (gn-gs M1 gn-f-skip 0) (+ i 1 k)))
    M))
newLoop:
(defn- fr-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64 Q :vector-i64] :vector-i64
  (if (and (< i (vector-at M MM-SIR-N)) (= (vector-at M MM-ERR) 0))
    (let [before (vector-at M MM-CODE-N) selected (fr-has M Q i 0)
          freg (gn-g M gn-f-freg) leaf (gn-g M gn-f-leaf) ctx (gn-g M gn-f-ctx)
          M1 (gn-ins M i (gn-op M i)) k (gn-g M1 gn-f-skip)
          note (if selected (fr-row "RI" [i before (vector-at M1 MM-CODE-N) k freg leaf ctx (vector-at M1 MM-ERR)]) 0)]
      (fr-loop (gn-gs M1 gn-f-skip 0) (+ i 1 k) Q))
    M))
(defn- gn-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64] :vector-i64 (fr-loop M i (fr-pick M)))
